# Beckhoff.TwinCAT.HMI.AuditTrailUtils

This package provides client-side utilities for working with audit trails in TwinCAT HMI applications.

## Usage

Add `Beckhoff.TwinCAT.HMI.AuditTrailUtils` to your TwinCAT HMI project to enable advanced audit trail features and utilities, such as filtering, exporting, and integration with AuditTrail controls.

## Documentation

For detailed usage and configuration, refer to the [Beckhoff TwinCAT HMI documentation](https://infosys.beckhoff.de/content/1033/te2000_tc3_hmi_engineering/index.html).
